applies_why: The text states a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS, so the RESULT rule governs whether that result is permitted.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — I weighed whether retracting the C3 BROKEN grade nullifies the standing and the only BROKEN collision, versus whether the standing still counts because the text labels it PROP-DEPENDENT.
why: The only stated basis for the standing and the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN collision are expressly retracted, and a retracted standing reason does not count, so the DEFENDER WINS result is not permitted.
